title.title: Mystery Files
title.overview: Have you ever found yourself on a Wikipedia deep dive on the weird side of the internet? In this show, weird thing enthusiasts Ryan and Shane take turns presenting their latest fascinations to each other covering everything unusual, unexplained, and unhinged.

videos.name: MYSTERY FILES with Ryan & Shane • Trailer
Ryan and Shane New Mystery Show • Mystery Files Teaser

episodes.name: The Unhinged Bank Heist of D.B. Tuber
episodes.overview: Ryan presents Shane with the wild tale of the D.B. Tuber bank heist. Sensitive Topics: Illegal activities, assault, drug use

episodes.name: The Largest Unexplained Explosion in History
episodes.overview: Shane explores Russia's strange Tunguska Event, Earth's largest recorded impact event. Sensitive Topics: Natural disasters, injuries

episodes.name: The Horrifying Killings of El Chupacabra
episodes.overview: Sensitive topics: deceased animals, mutilation. Ryan deep dives into one of the world's favorite cryptids, the notorious Chupacabra.

episodes.name: The Strange Disappearance of The Leatherman
episodes.overview: Shane investigates the legend of the lonely vagabond, The Leatherman, and the mysterious circumstances of his death. Sensitive topics: physical distress, death

episodes.name: The Apocalyptic Sounds Heard Around The World
episodes.overview: Ryan explores the strange noises that blared through the sky, christened as "The Sky Trumpets", and the possible explanations for their existence. Sensitive topics: physical/mental distress, aliens

episodes.name: The Maniacal TV Hijacking of Max Headroom
episodes.overview: Shane explores the disturbing Chicago news hijacking of "Max Headroom" and the feelings of fear that followed. Sensitive topics: static noises, mildly obscene activity (spanking)

episodes.name: The Sinister Letters That Terrorized A Small Town
episodes.overview: Ryan delves into the Circleville Letters, the bizarre, threatening letters that endlessly plagued a small town. Sensitive Topics: Stalking, Mention of Violence, Suicide, DUI, Murder.

episodes.name: The Perplexing Legend of Vermont's Sea Monster
episodes.overview: Shane explores the myth of Champ, the Nessie-like sea creature that supposedly lives in Lake Champlaign. Sensitive Topics: Cryptids

episodes.name: The Deranged Arsonist Who Filmed Their Own Crime
episodes.overview: Ryan tells Shane about the Stockton Arsonist, the mysterious pyromaniac who filmed his own crime. Sensitive Topics: Arson, Satanism, a brief mention of violence towards animals

episodes.name: The World’s Most Mysterious Book That No One Can Decode
episodes.overview: Shane goes on a deep dive into the Voynich Manuscript, the old book full of unexplained text and strange drawings that has a fanbase of its own. Sensitive Topics: N/A

episodes.name: The Toxic Blobs That Rained Down On Washington
episodes.overview: Ryan explores the incident of the Oakville Blobs, the strange goo that rained over Oakville, Washington and got residents and animals sick. Sensitive Topics: Animal death, illnesses, potential trypophobia

episodes.name: The Phantom Air Raid That Plunged Los Angeles into Darkness
episodes.overview: Shane tells Ryan about the Battle of Los Angeles, the bizarre air raid that took place in California during WWII and definitely NOT the movie. Sensitive topics: Descriptions of bodily injuries

episodes.name: Uncovering the Alien Encounters of the US Government
episodes.overview: Ryan explores the US Government's suspected involvement in aliens and UFO sightings in America. Sensitive topics: N/A

episodes.name: The Serial Killer Family That Terrorized The Old West
episodes.overview: Shane tells the tale of America's first serial killer family, The Bloody Benders, and the havoc they wreaked on the Old West. Sensitive topics: Descriptions of violence, murder

episodes.name: The Aliens That Terrorized A Kentucky Family In 1955
episodes.overview: Ryan dives into the bizarre extraterrestrial attack on a farmhouse in a small Kentucky town.

episodes.name: The Freaky Case of Gef the Talking Mongoose
episodes.overview: Shane tells the tale of Gef, the witty and slightly threatening talking mongoose who lived with the Irving family on the Isle of Man.

episodes.name: The Audacious Escape of Skyjacker D.B. Cooper
episodes.overview: Ryan revisits the daring escape of D.B. Cooper (his favorite case of all!)

episodes.name: The Grisly Crimes of the Czinkota Vampire
episodes.overview: Shane tells Ryan about Hungarian serial killer Béla Kiss and the disturbing crimes that took place in Czinkota.

episodes.name: The Eerie Case of Popper the Poltergeist
episodes.overview: Ryan tries, once again, to convince Shane that ghosts are real in the curious case of Popper the Poltergeist.

episodes.name: The Terrifying Mutilations of the Beast of Bladenboro
episodes.overview: Shane regales us with the a tale as old as time: A BIG OL' BEAST WITH A BIG OL' APPETITE!

episodes.name: Is Spontaneous Human Combustion Actually Real?
episodes.overview: Mystery Files is back and the boys get to play with fire! Don't worry, the set is still intact.

episodes.name: The Bizarre Case of Troublesome Creek's Blue Family
episodes.overview: Shane blue'd himself, but don't worry, he had help.

episodes.name: The Mystery of the Unsettling "Bloop"
episodes.overview: An underwater phenomenon or just a massive whale burp? Ryan dives deep into the mystery of the bloop!

episodes.name: The Disturbing Disappearance of the Princes in the Tower
episodes.overview: A murderous plot? A daring escape? A horrifying haunting? Grab a snack and help us unpack...wait, that's the wrong show. Strap in and stay alive as Shane recounts the tragic tale of two princes!

episodes.name: Is Bigfoot Real? (Revisited)
episodes.overview: We got the man, the myth, the legend to sit down in the chair with us today as Ryan and Shane revisit the mysterious case of Bigfoot!

episodes.name: The Outrageous Plot to Steal The Millennium Star Diamond
episodes.overview: We embark on our most daring Mystery Files stunt yet while covering the infamous Millennium Star Diamond heist!

episodes.name: The Icy Horrors of Dyatlov Pass
episodes.overview: Shane and Ryan are returning to the bunker to visit the snowy summits of Dyatlov Pass.

episodes.name: The Tragic Tale of the Pollock Twins
episodes.overview: Shane takes a walk in someone else's shoes...

episodes.name: The UFO Encounter in Rendlesham Forest
episodes.overview: What mysterious forces did the US Airforce stumble upon within the thicket of Rendlesham Forest? Ryan and Shane review firsthand encounters and receive one of their own...

episodes.name: The Zany Details of the Dekooning Art Heist
episodes.overview: Shane and Ryan immerse themselves in the wild misadventures of the Dekooning art heist.

episodes.name: The Strange Disappearance of Craig Williamson
episodes.overview: The boys investigate the bizarre missing persons case of Craig Williamson.

episodes.name: What Led to the Bizarre Disappearance of the Franklin Expedition?
episodes.overview: Shane and Ryan set sail on the mysterious tides of the Franklin Expedition!

episodes.name: Did the Atlantic Ocean Swallow Theodosia Burr Alston?
episodes.overview: What happened to Theodosia Burr Alston? Did she perish aboard The Patriot? Find a new land to escape her titles? Join the boys in the basement as they try to untangle the mystery surrounding the tragic disappearance of Aaron Burr's beloved daughter.

similar.title: Nurse the Dead
similar.subtitle: 2026 • PG
similar.overview: Tasked with saving LA’s most haunted hospital ward, a highly motivated Filipina nurse with a third eye must manage unruly ghosts, burned-out staff, and one judgmental “coworker” who knows her better than anyone should.

similar.title: D&D: Dungeon Masters
similar.overview: Dungeon Masters stars Jasmine Bhullar (DesiQuest, Dimension 20) as Dungeon Master, joined by Mayanna Berrin (Dispatch, The Dungeon Run), Christian Navarro (13 Reasons Why, Forgotten Realms), Neil Newbon (Baldur’s Gate III), and Devora Wilde (Baldur’s Gate III) and features an all-original score by five-time, Grammy-nominated composer David Arkenstone.

similar.title: Grave Conversations
similar.overview: An unforgettable journey into the depths of human existence, while David Dastmalchian guides his guests through discussions that delve into personal reflections on mortality, legacy, and the afterlife, all while lying down in Titan caskets.

similar.title: The Studio
similar.overview: Paul, an underdog music producer, juggles family life and artistic dreams by working out of his home studio with a rotating cast of eccentric clients, creating original music and navigating hilarious family drama along the way.

similar.title: Police 24/7
similar.subtitle: 2024 • TV-14
similar.overview: This adrenaline-packed series delivers raw, unfiltered access into the world of sheriffs and police departments across the United States as they serve and protect at all costs. From drug busts to routine traffic stops, you never know what to expect, but these officers are ready 24/7 to keep their communities safe.

similar.title: The Long Pour
similar.overview: The Long Pour is a late 1920s New York Prohibition-era crime drama following the Italian-American Rinaldi family, who quietly control one of the city’s most sophisticated bootlegging empires. Led by Don Salvatore “Tore” Rinaldi, his wife, and his 5 sons, the family profits by maintaining and controlling Prohibition and carefully balancing supply, scarcity, and corruption to keep illegal alcohol highly lucrative.

similar.title: Regular Show: The Lost Tapes
similar.subtitle: 2026 • TV-PG
similar.overview: Familiar duo Mordecai and Rigby navigate mundane park jobs that inevitably spiral into surreal, chaotic disasters.
